comment: ANCHOR: N8N_BACKUP_BUNDLE_20261106 - n8n program 0.2a: the policy view for the n8n Drive copy, verify-before-prune on a fake Drive, an unverified or unreachable Drive alerting and deleting nothing, the receipt written on failure, and a volume archive without the encryption-key config refused.
